page.overview:
Who is Donnamira Took?

Donnamira Boffin (née Took) was a Hobbit of the Shire and an aunt of Bilbo Baggins.

Donnamira was the tenth child of Gerontius "the Old" Took and Adamanta Chubb. Donnamira had nine older siblings: Isengrim III, Hildigard, Isumbras IV, Hildigrim, Isembold, Hildifons, Isembard, Hildibrand, and Belladonna; and two younger siblings: Mirabella and Isengar. She married Hugo Boffin and had two children Jago and Jessamine. She died in TA 2948 (SR 1348).
